ftb.guhs_techniek.section.fabriek: The Factory Hall: wool, colour and building blocks
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fabriek_spin.title: Whirring Spinner
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fabriek_spin.desc: Build a &dSpinning Machine&r and spin &ffluff&r into wool: 2 fluff is 1 white wool. Fluff comes from Cloud Lambs (shearing) or the Plushie Recycler.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fabriek_verf.title: Splash in the Dye Bath
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fabriek_verf.desc: Put wool and dye in the &dDye Bath&r: it dyes everything the game can dye, glass, clay and cuddle blocks too.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fabriek_scheerstal.d: Keep tame &dCloud Lambs&r around a &dShearing Stable&r: it shears them by itself. Tame them with fluffgrass or cloud candy floss and breed them with cloud candy floss!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fabriek_recycler.des: Put old plushies, guh clothes, wool or cushions into the &dPlushie Recycler&r: fluff comes out.
Put an &dexample&r in the &dBuilding Block Factory&r: it makes stairs, slabs, walls, smooth and coloured blocks. Link a Bank Guh (Bank Key) or a chest (sneak + click, then the chest).
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fabriek_kleurmolen.t: All the Colours of the Rainbow
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fabriek_kleurmolen.d: Grind flowers in the &dColour Mill&r: 2 to 3 dye per flower. Let a guh do the chore &dPicking Flowers&r for an endless supply!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.fabriek_regenboogper: Press fluff and &6cheese sauce&r into any colour in the &dRainbow Press&r. Pick the colour with sneak + click, or put down an example dye.
